questions.scenario: A retail company wants to create original promotional images from short text descriptions written by its marketing team. The solution must be built in Microsoft Foundry.
questions.question: Which type of model should the company deploy?

options.text: An image-generation model such as gpt-image-1
options.why: Correct. Image-generation models create new images from text prompts.
Embedding models return vectors that represent meaning. They do not produce images.
Speech models convert between audio and text and cannot create images.
Image analysis describes and tags existing images. It does not create new ones.

questions.explanation: Creating a new visual output from a text description requires an image-generation model, such as gpt-image-1, deployed in Foundry.

questions.question: You call images.generate by using the OpenAI client obtained from an AIProjectClient. Which value must you pass in the model parameter?

options.text: The name of the Foundry resource
options.why: The resource name is part of the endpoint, not the model parameter.

options.text: The name of the image model deployment
options.why: Correct. The model parameter identifies the deployment that serves the request.
The endpoint is passed when the AIProjectClient is created.
Authentication is handled by the credential object, not the model parameter.

questions.explanation: In Foundry SDK calls, the model parameter is the deployment name of the model that should process the request.

questions.question: Which TWO settings can you specify when you generate an image with gpt-image-1?

options.why: Correct. Size sets the resolution and aspect ratio, such as 1024x1024 or 1536x1024.
Correct. Quality, such as low, medium or high, controls detail, generation time and cost.
Speaker diarization is a speech-to-text feature.
Confidence scores apply to extracted fields in Content Understanding, not to image generation.

questions.explanation: Size and quality are the main generation settings for gpt-image-1, together with the prompt and the number of images.

questions.question: A news organization needs a way to verify whether an image published by a partner was created by an Azure OpenAI image model. Which feature supports this requirement?

options.why: Prompt Shields detect jailbreak and prompt injection attacks in inputs.
Correct. Generated images include signed C2PA provenance metadata that identifies them as AI-generated.
Groundedness detection checks whether text responses are supported by source data.
OCR reads text inside an image and does not establish its origin.

questions.explanation: Content credentials attach C2PA provenance information to generated images so their AI origin can be verified.

questions.question: A designer likes a generated product image but wants only the background replaced with a beach scene. What should the designer do?

options.text: Use image editing with gpt-image-1 and describe the change, optionally with a mask
options.why: Correct. Image editing changes part of an existing image based on an instruction.

options.text: Send the image to a text analysis service
options.why: Text analysis works on text, not images.

options.text: Increase the temperature of a chat model deployment
options.why: Temperature affects randomness in text generation and does not edit images.
prebuilt-layout extracts document structure. It does not change images.

questions.explanation: gpt-image-1 supports editing, so an instruction such as replacing the background can be applied to an existing image, with a mask to limit the change.
